record.body:
## Requirements

R1: When an effort's snapshot includes one or more milestones, the main pane shows a Phases block that groups that effort's phases under those milestones instead of the flat phase stepper.
R2: Each milestone group header shows the milestone title (else subject), its state, and its done/total counts from the snapshot milestone row.
R3: Phases with no milestone appear in an Ungrouped group after all milestone groups.
R4: When an effort has no milestones, the existing flat phase stepper remains the phase control.
R5: Selecting a phase in the Phases block filters the task table to that phase using the same scoping rules as today's stepper.
R6: An All phases control remains available and shows tasks across every phase of the effort.
R7: A milestone whose state is done starts collapsed; the user can expand and collapse it.
R8: The milestone that contains the currently selected phase (or the default phase when following) starts expanded.
R9: Activating the already-selected phase opens the phase detail overlay for that phase.
R10: Phase rows show title when present, otherwise subject, plus a done/total cue for that phase.

## Acceptance criteria

- Component or unit tests with seeded snapshot fixtures cover: grouping by milestone, Ungrouped placement, empty-milestones flat-stepper fallback, finished-milestone collapse default, and expand-current-milestone.
- `npm test` in `dashboard/web/ui` passes for those cases.
- Manual: with this repo's store, open the web dashboard, select `dashboard`, and confirm phases under `web-calm` appear under that milestone header with finished older milestones collapsed or absent from the expanded set as specified.

## Constraints

- No new HTTP endpoints; use `effort.milestones` and per-phase `milestone` / `milestone_title` already on `GET /api/snapshot`.
- Do not change Textual or `dashboard/bin/dashboard` in this phase.
- Preserve existing `defaultPhase` / `resolvedPhase` / pin behavior except where collapse/expand UI state is added.

## Non-goals

- Journal rail changes (phase `side-rail-calm`).
- Deep-linking of ids in markdown (phase `deep-links`).
- Phase overview redesign or task graph (later web-calm phases).
- Creating or editing milestones from the UI.
- Changing how `dashboard.model` computes milestone rows.

## Invariants

- Phase selection still drives task-table scope; Needs you and Backlog stay effort-wide.
- Snapshot polling and theme behavior are unchanged.

## Assumptions

- `effort.milestones` in the snapshot is the ordered list from `dashboard.model` (`MilestoneRow`: subject, title, ordinal, state, done, total).
- A milestone is "finished" for collapse when its `state` is `done`.
